source.title: Proven Safety Countermeasures
source.publisher: Federal Highway Administration, U.S. Department of Transportation
source.terms: U.S. federal government work (17 U.S.C. 105). Free to use.
source.retrievalNote: The FHWA site refused direct automated download on 2026-10-13 and again on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 403). On 2026-11-13 the list page, the six Roadway Departure pages and the Pavement Friction Management page were read in full as text through a reader service (r.jina.ai) that fetched the live FHWA pages; the six entries added that day summarize what their pages say. The ten earlier entries still on the list match names on the list page, and nine match its URLs; Roundabouts still points to an older FHWA roundabouts page, while the list now links its own countermeasure page. Their crash types and descriptions come from 2026-10-13 web search results and were not re-read. [VERIFY] each earlier entry against its FHWA page before a plan is published.

listNote: FHWA's list page, read 2026-11-13, names 23 countermeasures in four groups: Pedestrian (6), Roadway Departure (6), Intersections (7) and Crosscutting (4). This file carries 16 of those 23, including all six Roadway Departure items. It does not carry Backplates with Retroreflective Borders, Corridor Access Management, Reduced Left-Turn Conflict Intersections, Systemic Application of Multiple Low-Cost Countermeasures at Stop-Controlled Intersections, Yellow Change Intervals, Local Road Safety Plans or Road Safety Audit. It keeps four entries that the 2026-11-13 list page does not show (Road Diets (Roadway Configuration), Bicycle Lanes, Appropriate Speed Limits for All Road Users, Speed Safety Cameras) because saved plans cite them; FHWA's own countermeasure pages for road diets and appropriate speed limits returned 404 that day. [VERIFY] whether FHWA withdrew those four items.
cmfPolicy: A crash modification factor is shown only with its CMF Clearinghouse ID, after that entry has been read. No entry was read for this version, so every value is left out and marked [VERIFY].
